answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 9900 Country: India Title: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Question: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer ID: 9900 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
